entities.summary: Raymond Lloyd is an American martial artist, professional wrestler and actor. He is signed to All Elite Wrestling (AEW) as a coach and trainer. He is best known for his appearances with World Championship Wrestling from 1996 to 1999 under the ring name Glacier.
